RxMavlink.ShowTelemetry_comment: 1: open the telemetry window on Start
RxMavlink.ForwardMavlink_comment: 1: send every received MAVLink frame by UDP to MavlinkTo (a ground station)
RxMavlink.MavlinkTo_comment: host:port of the ground station; QGroundControl and Mission Planner listen on 14550
RxMavlink.ForwardVideo_comment: 1: send the received MPEG-TS video by UDP to VideoTo
RxMavlink.VideoTo_comment: host:port; QGroundControl: Video source MPEG-TS on this port (default 5600)
RxMavlink.SaveTlog_comment: 1: save the received MAVLink frames to App/Mavlink/Received.tlog
